items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: I went to Tuk Johnson in first quarter of 24. ... I still belong to Tuk Johnson band

ctx.x: Is that the Tuk Johnson band up there?
Oh, yeah. Uh-huh. You said that was 1924, would that be? Yeah, well that was Tony Harris's band. And it was, do you think that was in 1924 as well, so?

items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: Then there was Zell, he was with Redhead, yeah, he was with Redhead, he was supposed to beat him.

ctx.x: Yes. When you got to New Orleans, who was the best down at play in town next to you?

Well, no, that's kind of a whole dance. That's a loaded question. Yeah, because I still like Joe Watson to my idea. Then there was Zell, he was with Redhead, yeah, he was with Redhead, he was supposed to beat him. Oh, yeah. Then there was Piku, Teo, all those guys, man.
Did Piku play much jazz in those days?

items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: To Johnson had been after me for about six or eight months to come up and join his band... I told him to come up there.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. What caused you to leave the band in the end, you know, wouldn't you?

Yes, uh, the music had got slow, things had got kind of, you know, bad. With Tom's band or with all the bands? Yeah, with all the bands, right. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. And I had gotten married then, and, uh, expecting my first child and I needed some money. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. To Johnson had been after me for about six or eight months to come up and join his band. He thought it was a pretty good salary. And, uh, I sit down and talk to Mr. Tom about it. And, uh, he told me I'd be a fool if I didn't go take him. Because he was…
But you were here, you mean, or you were in New Orleans? Yeah, I was in New Orleans. Yeah, yeah.

items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: I took him down since Walton got me in a move.

ctx.x: But you were here, you mean, or you were in New Orleans? Yeah, I was in New Orleans. Yeah, yeah.
And, uh, I took him down since Walton got me in a move. What year was that about? You remember Tom? I went to Tuk Johnson in first quarter of 24. Uh-huh.
Is that the Tuk Johnson band up there?
